about: REIT 1 Ltd., established in 2006 as Israel's first Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT), was created following the approval of REIT structures by Israeli authorities to enable broad public participation in large-scale commercial property investments. REITs have been widely used globally since the 1960s, and REIT 1 owns and operates a portfolio of nearly 750,000 square meters located in attractive locations and submarkets throughout Israel.
